author: Susanna Khloyan
businessNeed: Customers currently must call the contact center to freeze a lost or misplaced card, resulting in average handling times of 8+ minutes and a spike in fraud exposure during the delay. This document defines the requirements for a self-service Instant Card Freeze & Unfreeze capability in the Digital Banking Platform's mobile and web channels.
businessObjectives: Let customers freeze/unfreeze their own card in under 10 seconds via mobile or web banking.
Reduce card-related contact center call volume by at least 30%.
Reduce fraud losses attributable to delayed card freezing.

successMetrics.target: ≥ 70% of freeze actions done via app/web within 90 days

currentState: Customers call the contact center, are authenticated via KBA, and an agent manually freezes the card in the core card management system. Average handling time is 8+ minutes; the card remains active until the call is completed.
futureState: Customers open the app or web banking, select the card, and tap Freeze. The card is frozen instantly in the core card management system, a confirmation is shown, and a push/SMS notification is sent. Unfreezing follows the same self-service flow.
inScope: Freeze/unfreeze for active, physical and virtual debit and credit cards owned by the authenticated customer.
Mobile app and web banking channels.
Push/SMS notification on freeze and unfreeze.
Contact center agent visibility into current freeze status.
outOfScope: Freeze/unfreeze initiated by joint account holders on behalf of another cardholder.
businessRules: Only the cardholder can freeze/unfreeze their own card; joint account holders cannot freeze another holder's card.
A frozen card blocks all new authorizations (POS, ATM, online) but does not reverse already-settled transactions.
Recurring/subscription payments already authorized before the freeze may still be governed by the card network's rules; this must be clearly disclosed to the customer.
Cards already reported lost/stolen or already permanently blocked cannot be unfrozen through this feature.

epics.title: Instant Card Freeze & Unfreeze
epics.description: Allow a customer to instantly freeze and unfreeze their own debit/credit card via mobile and web banking, with immediate effect in the core card management system.

narrative.soThat: I can stop new transactions if I've misplaced it

acceptanceCriteria.given: the customer views an active card in the app
acceptanceCriteria.then: the card status changes to Frozen in the core system within 3 seconds and the UI reflects it

acceptanceCriteria.when: a new transaction is attempted on that card
acceptanceCriteria.then: the transaction is declined by the issuer
the customer receives a push/SMS confirmation and an audit log entry is created

narrative.soThat: I can resume using it once I've found it or resolved my concern

acceptanceCriteria.given: the customer views a frozen card (not lost/stolen-blocked)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the card status changes to Active within 3 seconds

acceptanceCriteria.given: a card has been reported lost/stolen
acceptanceCriteria.when: the customer attempts to unfreeze it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system blocks the action and directs them to the card replacement flow

narrative.iWant: to see a customer's current card freeze status
narrative.soThat: I can support their inquiry without needing to change the status myself

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authorized agent opens a customer's card record
acceptanceCriteria.then: the current freeze status and last 5 status-change events are visible

dataRequirements.description: Card status (Active/Frozen/Blocked), product type, masked PAN.
Identity and contact details for authentication and notification.
Timestamped record of every freeze/unfreeze action and actor.

risks.risk: Card network does not guarantee real-time propagation of freeze status to all acquirers.
risks.mitigation: Confirm network SLA with card scheme; disclose any propagation delay to customers in-app.

risks.risk: Customers freeze a card unaware it blocks pre-authorized recurring payments, causing complaints.
risks.mitigation: In-app disclosure before confirming freeze; contact center talking points.

risks.risk: Low awareness of the new self-service feature limits contact-center call reduction target.
risks.mitigation: In-app promotion and push notification campaign at launch.
